F-zntb (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 18) - SOURCE-ASSISTED READING, not a blind reading. Made with the Morimondo antiphoner (Paris, BnF, NAL 1411, ff. 71v-72v) available. Lines reread on the image: all text lines of both faces, in bands at reading size, with contrast-enhanced crops of the faded Cum immundus line on canvas 0. Base: readings/stams-2026-10-30-image-only.json. Neumes not transcribed.
Boxes are native pixels x1,y1,x2,y2 on 7360 x 4912 images. Text order: canvas 1 (labelled 01v, fol. 56r, "LVI") then canvas 0 (labelled 01r, fol. 56v). (abc) = expansion; [abc] = lost or supplied; ? = uncertain.

CANVAS 1 (fol. 56r)
Foliation "LVI" at head (2600,200,5700,800).
Band 2780,500,5600,1400:
[Memento mei dum bene tibi fue]rit. Vt suggeras pharaoni ut educat me de isto carcere quia furtim sublatus sum & hic innocens in lacum missus sum. V. Tres enim adhuc dies sunt post quos recordabitur pharao ministerii tui & restituet te in gradum pristinum tunc memento mei. Vt suggeras.
Band 2780,2150,5600,3050 (middle lines faded):
R. Tollite hinc uobiscum munera & ite ad dominum terre & cum inueneritis adorate eum super terram Deus autem meus faciat uobis eum pla-cabi-lem & remittat et hunc fratrem uestrum uobiscum & eum quem tenet in uinculis. V. Tollite de frugibus terre in uasis uestris & deferte uiro munera. De(u)s.
Band 2700,3000,5700,4000:
R. Iste est frater uester minimus de quo [dix]eratis mi chi De us misereatur tibi fili mi Festinauitq(ue) in do-/-mum & plorauit quia erumpebant la cri me & non poterat se [con]tinere. V. Attollens autem ioseph oculos uidit beniamin stan-

-tem commota sunt omnia uiscera eius super fratre suo. Festinauitque / [in domum?] (two heavy words at 2500,980,3300,1180 read as "indo mum"?, taken uncertainly as the rest of the repetendum cue). R. Dixit ruben fratribus suis numquid non dixi uobis nolite peccare in puerum & non audistis me En sanguis eius exquiritur. V. Merito hec patimur quia peccauimus in fratrem nostrum uidentes angustiam anime eius dum deprecaretur nos & non audiuimus. En sanguis.
Lines 2500,2180,5250,2350 (blue-channel enhanced) and 3800,2580,5250,2720:
[red] Ad cc(antica) [red initial] C um immundus spiritus exierit ab homine ambulat per loca inaquosa querens requiem & non inue[nit] [differentia, e u o u a e?]. Middle of the line abraded.
